_comment: prompts/33 section 1.5: one Perlmutter job per token (1 GPU, shared QOS). scripts/run_gate.py runs <script> <args> for a token that has no scripts/gate_<T>.py; ci/allowed_jobs.campaign33 is generated from this file (skqd.campaign33.tokens.allowlist_text). The token index (order of this file, comment excluded) fixes the base seed 33000000 + 1e5 x index (prompts/33 2.3). prompts/33a step D appends the 20 generic slots C4_PART_01..20 after the 33 tokens (the 33 indices, hence their seeds, are unchanged); ci/allowed_jobs.campaign33a lists them.

C1_IDEAL.content: IR-L0, NAT-O0, IBM-U/T0/T3 exactness vs the exact Krylov states; noiseless sampling at the f=0.10 plan and 2e5 per sector; the f=1 SKQD reference

C2_CAL.content: 21-qubit timing ladder {8,32,128,512} on B0_ref117_k1 (IBM-T0), Kraus vs PTA, cuStateVec vs batched; sizes C2_*

C2_GATE.content: I-GATE on IBM-U, both K1 circuits

C2_XY4.content: I-XY4 on IBM-T3, echo and star halves (information)

C3_AER.content: NAT-O0 noiseless on Aer: per-state agreement; f=1 SKQD reference of the native family

C3_LE.content: pytket-pecos H2-1LE local emulator (noiseless, CPU) on the 4 Stage-E circuits

C3_SEL.content: optional: Selene (QuEST, IdealErrorModel) on the QIR export of the 4 Stage-E circuits

C4_FCELLS_A.content: 10-min ladder then f-cells E1,E2,E3,E4,E5a/b/c x O0-O4 (+O6 info)

C4_FCELLS_B.content: f-cells E6a/b/c, E7(0.05/0.07/0.10/0.15) x O0-O4; faithful S3 redo (IR-L3-RZZ, E8, 32 x 100, seed 11)

C4_F1_B0.content: E1 x O0 plan-of-record run, B=0

C4_F1_B1.content: E1 x O0 plan-of-record run, B=1

C4_F4_B0a.content: E7(0.10) x O0, S3-quota half a, B=0 (1e5)

C4_F4_B0b.content: E7(0.10) x O0, S3-quota half b, B=0 (1e5)

C4_F4_B1a.content: E7(0.10) x O0, S3-quota half a, B=1 (1e5)

C4_F4_B1b.content: E7(0.10) x O0, S3-quota half b, B=1 (1e5)

C4_F5_B0.content: E7(0.07) x O0 at the f=0.10 plan, B=0

C4_F5_B1.content: E7(0.07) x O0 at the f=0.10 plan, B=1

C4_F7_B0.content: E1 x the chosen exact variant, B=0

C4_F7_B1.content: E1 x the chosen exact variant, B=1

C4_F8_B0a.content: E8, S3-quota half a, B=0: the S3 recall criterion

C4_CF.content: CF_traj redo on the GPU: K=2000 faulty Pauli trajectories per arm
